text:
maya: quick heads-up — sampleapp rerank batcher corrupted vectors after a retry yesterday
kevin: corrupted how?
maya: some items ended up 1536 instead of expected 1024; local trace shows same inputs but retry path merged responses
sam: any code / logs?
maya: minimal log:
```
2026-03-22T12:01:02Z batch=bb-777 attempt=1 POST /v1/embeddings ids=8 dim=1024 -> 200
2026-03-22T12:01:03Z batch=bb-777 attempt=2 POST /v1/embeddings ids=8 dim=512 -> 200
client-merge -> item[2] length=1536
```
alex: that looks like a client concat bug when merging partials
kevin: do we have the merge helper?
maya: yes — old node helper did this:
```
// bad: assumes partials are segments
function mergeResponses(base, partial) {
  return base.map((b, i) => partial[i] ? b.concat(partial[i]) : b);
}
```
sam: wow. python helper throws on mismatch, node helper was lenient -> parity gap
kevin: also spotted retry header diffs in the trace; first attempt had x-request-group + x-batch-id, retry only preserved x-batch-id so SmartRouting could route to a cheaper 512-dim variant
maya: short term fixes pushed to sampleapp: replace concat with replace semantics, add dim validation (throw on mismatch), and preserve routing/idempotency headers across retries. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/sampleapp/pull/1012
sam: i'll add unit + e2e that injects a mismatched partial and assert the client errors instead of corrupting vectors
ci-bot: pipeline queued -> devex/embedding-batcher-dim-guard -> started
kevin: docs: add onboarding note clarifying canonical response keys (`embedding` vs `embeddings`) and recommend idempotency headers (Idempotency-Key / x-batch-id + x-request-group) for retries
alex: changelog: call out "embedding-batcher: stricter merge semantics (breaking)" so downstreams know behavior changed if they relied on concat
maya: follow-ups: scan SDKs for concat patterns, add parity linting rule, stage smoke for rerank pages after CI green
kevin: assign sam (tests/e2e), maya (hotfix + docs + scan), alex (changelog). ETA EOD tomorrow
maya: EOD works for me :thumbsup:
